aboutP1:
Hi, I'm Lity.

Stories by Lity was born from love - the love I have for my little nephew.

When he came into my life, I found myself imagining all the stories I would one day tell him before bed. Even though he's only a tiny baby, I wanted to create a collection of stories that he could grow up with - stories filled with wonder, kindness, courage, laughter and love.

What started as a gift for one precious child has become a dream to share those stories with children and families everywhere.

Every story I write is created with care, hoping to spark imagination, encourage curiosity, and leave little hearts feeling safe, happy and inspired.

My wish is simple: that every child who visits Stories by Lity finds a story they'll want to hear again and again, creating beautiful memories with the people they love most.

Thank you for being here and for letting Stories by Lity become a small part of your family's journey.

With love,

Lity
aboutP2: At Stories by Lity, every story is written with love and care to inspire young minds. Through gentle adventures, lovable characters, and meaningful lessons, we hope to make bedtime a little more magical and reading a joyful habit for every child.
